name: crypto_funding_carry
written: 2026-11-11, before any funding or price history was downloaded or looked at
question: operator 11/11: is there anything like the desk that makes money? Candidate: crypto funding-rate carry. Hold the coin, short the same amount of its perpetual future, collect the funding payments; the two legs cancel the coin's price move.
data: public exchange history, fetched as JSON from documented public endpoints, no account. Order of preference: Binance USDT-margined perpetuals (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT: funding every 8 h since 2019, 8-hour bars for the perpetual and for spot); if that is not reachable from here, BitMEX (XBTUSD funding since 2016 with its index) or Deribit. Whatever source is used is named in the result. Full history, nothing dropped: March 2020, May 2021, the 2022 failures (Luna, FTX) and every later episode stay in.
position: 1 unit of spot long and 1 unit of perpetual short, re-equalised every funding period. Per period P&L on the notional = funding received by the short (rate x notional; negative when the rate is negative) + the change in (spot - perpetual) / spot (the basis) . Capital = 1.0 for the coin + 0.5 as margin for the short = 1.5 per 1.0 of notional; returns are on that 1.5.
costs: 0.10% per side on spot and 0.05% per side on the perpetual (plain taker fees, no discounts): 0.30% of notional per round trip. ALWAYS-ON pays one round trip per year (re-entry once a year is assumed). SWITCHED pays a round trip every time it turns on and off.

strategies.primary: ALWAYS-ON, BTC and ETH separately, then half of each.
strategies.secondary: SWITCHED: on only while the average funding rate of the last 21 periods (7 days) is above +0.01% per 8 h, off otherwise (cash at 0%). Fixed here, not tuned.

pass: ALWAYS-ON half-and-half: net return on capital > 0 in BOTH halves of the history; pooled net return at least 2 percentage points a year above what cash paid (cash taken as roughly 0.5% in 2020, 0.1% in 2021, 2% in 2022, 5% in 2023-2024, 4% in 2025-2026: approximate, stated as such); worst rolling 12 months no worse than -5%; and the short leg is never within 10% of liquidation with 50% margin topped up each period (largest single-period rise in the coin < 40%).
reported_whatever_the_verdict: share of periods with negative funding and the longest negative stretch
how many years of carry one exchange failure would erase if the capital on that exchange were lost (a scenario, not a probability: the history cannot say how likely a failure is)
what_this_cannot_show: exchange failure, frozen withdrawals and hacks: the largest real risk, and not in any price series

whether a venue a US resident may legally use pays the same funding; the longest histories are on venues that do not accept US customers, and the rules have been changing (to be checked separately before anything else)
taxes, and the cost of moving margin between the two legs
slippage in a crash, when both legs are hard to trade at once
no_money: a backtest only. Nothing is opened, no account is created, no order is placed.
data_used: Deribit public API (BTC-PERPETUAL, ETH-PERPETUAL), hourly funding and prices 2019-04-30 to 2026-11-11, 8,255 complete 8-hour periods per coin. Binance and Bybit refuse US connections (HTTP 451 / 403) and BitMEX returned 403; not worked around.
bug_fixed_before_reporting: the first run read the future's price one hour after the coin's (Deribit chart bars are keyed by their start), which made the hedged position look like it moved up to 10% in 8 hours. Fixed and covered by a test before any result was reported; no rule or threshold changed.
result_2026-11-11: FAIL on one condition. ALWAYS-ON half BTC / half ETH, after fees, on capital of 1.5 per 1.0 of position: +4.33% a year (halves +5.07% / +3.60%) against cash of about 2.8% over the span, i.e. +1.5 points, short of the +2 required. The other three conditions passed: worst 12 months -3.05% (limit -5%), worst drawdown -5.2%, largest 8-hour rise 17% (limit 40%). By year: 2019 +5.5, 2020 +5.1, 2021 +11.6, 2022 -2.9, 2023 +4.7, 2024 +6.3, 2025 +1.9, 2026 to date +0.9. BTC alone +5.0% a year, ETH alone +3.6%. SWITCHED (secondary): +3.5% a year, worst 12 months -0.6%, in the trade 29% of the time, 2025 -0.2% and 2026 0.0%. Reading: the carry is real and steady but small, and it has shrunk: in 2025-2026 it paid less than cash. One exchange failure would erase about 23 years of it on the capital held there.
